title: Location
description: Location bible (production/locations/<LOC_ID>/location.yaml): identity, canonical description, and registry of reference assets for set-consistent generation.

id.description: Base location ID without version suffix (e.g. LOC_STATION).

type.description: Set type; mixed covers locations with both (e.g. covered platform).

description.description: Canonical description; prompts are compiled from these fields.

summary.description: One-paragraph generation-ready description of the space.

key_features.description: Landmarks that must appear consistently (benches, clock, signage).

sounds.description: Ambient sound bed; used by sound design.

lighting_notes.description: How the location is lit across times of day; the style bible refines this.

map_file.description: Relative path to this location's map.yaml (location-map.schema.json).

references.description: Registry of location reference assets. Approved masters are immutable; supersede with a new _V## version.

kind.description: What the reference establishes about the space.
